subject: Offer kit routing + approvals for Samantha June (Sr. Data Engineer)
thread_body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer kit routing + approvals for Samantha June (Sr. Data Engineer)

Hi team,

I'm preparing the formal offer kit for Samantha June (candidate) — role: Sr. Data Engineer (IC4). Please confirm the approvals routing so I can create the offer in Greenhouse and push the DocuSign packet. Current details below:

- Proposed base: $185,000
- Target total cash (OTE): $200,000
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.12% (4-year, 1Y cliff)
- Start: target 2027-06-21
- GH job id: RED-1245

Checklist I'm planning to follow in Greenhouse:
1) Create Offer in GH (Offer tab) -> attach offer letter PDF
2) Choose pay components: Base + Sign-on + Equity; mark as contingent on background
3) Route approvals: Hiring Manager (Dev) -> Eng Director (Lauren) -> Recruiting Ops (Marissa) -> People Ops (offers@peopleops.co) -> Finance (if comp exception)
4) If compensation outside band, attach comp band exception ticket
5) Send DocuSign link to candidate with Notice, Offer Letter, Equity Schedule

Asks: can Lauren + Dev confirm the base and equity above? Lauren, would you like me to route a comp-exception to Finance if you want to push base to $190k, or do you sign off at $185k?

Target: create offer in GH tomorrow (5/25) by EOD and send to candidate 5/26.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Recruiter | Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer kit routing + approvals for Samantha June (Sr. Data Engineer)

Thanks Connor — looks good. I'm comfortable approving up to $187,500 base (total cash ~202.5k) without escalating to Finance. If Dev wants to push to $190k we should route the comp-exception.

Please include the Comp_Band_Sr_SW_2027Q2.pdf in the packet and route to Recruiting Ops (Marissa) for standard compliance checks (equity language + bench approvals). Marissa: please confirm you'll run the GH offer audit and confirm equity vesting language matches comp band.

- Lauren
Director, Engineering

---
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer kit routing + approvals for Samantha June (Sr. Data Engineer)

Lauren — agreed on $187.5k base. Add a $15k pro-rated sign-on instead of $20k (candidate prefers earlier start flexibility). Equity is fine at 0.12% but candidate asked if we could accelerate to a 3.5 year schedule — I don't think we should change standard vesting; keep 4y/1y.

Connor: please set sign-on to $15k and route to Lauren for final sign-off. No Finance escalation needed.

Thanks,
Dev
Hiring Manager, Data Platform
